title: console AI: the tool-approval buttons and the Builder handoff card still render hard-coded English ("Approve & run", "Reject", "Open in Builder →") in every locale (objectui#2458 item 4, third class)
body:
Path: ⑤ connect an Agent and have it complete a real business operation — the AI build surface | 缺项 (no item asserts the AI chat's action labels are localized) | P5

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. It is a single-scope child of objectui#2458 (item 4), split on the maintainer's order (director `6006198254`). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (about `:2463`–`:2465`), the props it passes to `ChatbotEnhanced`, and `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the host passes literal English, and leaves the handoff card's English defaults in place.

## Read on objectui `main` (`fc3c2cc1cf`)

- `AiChatPage.tsx` passes `toolApproveLabel="Approve & run"`, `toolDenyLabel="Reject"` and `toolDenyReason="Operator rejected from chat"` (about `:2463`–`:2465`) as literals.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` documents English defaults for the ADR-0057 P4 handoff card: the heading "Build this in the Builder", the action "Open in Builder →" (about `:654`–`:656`), and "A newer request is available". No host passes translated values.
- The comment `5228506525` on objectui#2458 flagged "Open in Builder →" as 「需单独核」 (needs a separate check). The other two classes of that item are delivered: the tool-name table (objectui#7254 and #7481) and 「Build Doctor」 (objectui#10900 and #10969).

## Done when

- Every one of those labels reaches the user through `t(...)`, with keys present in all locales. The deny reason recorded on the tool call is a translated label, not a fixed English sentence, unless it is a machine-read value, in which case it stays and is named as such in the PR.
- A test renders the AI chat in `zh-CN` and finds none of those English strings, and is ablated once.

`bug` (the console's own i18n contract: every user-visible label is localized) · `priority:p3` · `area:i18n`.
